Package com.egradx.notification.delivery

Class EgradxBulkExpander

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.delivery.EgradxBulkExpander
public class EgradxBulkExpander extends Object
Turns bulk sends into deliveries, one page of recipients per call.

Each page is one transaction: lock the oldest bulk send still expanding (skipping any another instance holds), take the next page of user ids after expanded_through, resolve each to an address and a language, render the message once per language, write the deliveries, and move expanded_through on. If the instance dies, the page rolls back and the next call — here or elsewhere — does it again. Nothing is expanded twice and nobody is skipped.

Users with no address on the channel are counted, not failed: in a send to a whole organization, some people will not have WhatsApp. So, for a send that honours preferences, are users who opted out of this kind of message.

Two kinds of failure, treated differently:

  • The template no longer renders (edited since the send was accepted): the send is marked FAILED with the reason. Retrying would fail the same way.
  • Anything else — the directory or database unreachable: logged, and the page is tried again on the next poll. It never stops ordinary deliveries from being sent in between.
